text.tspan: Since each outcome of each coin toss is equally likely, we can use a sample space to answer
the question. The easiest way to organize the possible sequences is to use a tree diagram.
: Tree diagram for sequence of three coin-flips.
for the completed “tree diagram” after three coin-tosses. Tree diagrams are
helpful when you need to keep track of sequences of outcomes.
1) The result of the first coin toss will
be either heads or tails. The
sequences of three results will look
like H _ _ or T _ _ after the first coin
2) The second coin toss adds heads or tails branches to
each of the first two possible sequences. After two coin
tosses the possible sequences will be H H _, H T _, T
